title: Relight · placed lights on a portrait
description: The Relight tool's Generate lighting (Qwen-Image 2.1 + Viggle's 6-step speed LoRA, words written from the placed lights by src/lib/relight/lights.ts) on 12 portraits you supply in local/relight/<id>.png: 8 editorial portraits and 4 more. Each case runs the four named looks, Neon night with its softness said once, and one white and one teal light at each of the 9 side x height spots (the 'lands where placed' check). Measures identity against the photo (the acceptance bar is 0.85 on every portrait at 100 %, median 0.90), CLIP and aesthetic. Today's Relight engine (Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, 8 steps) and the older Light-Migration path run the same words for comparison. The guide-picture, Pruna 8-step and r128 arms change the graph itself, so they run as graphs of their own and are recorded next to this suite. Light placement, stray colour cast, background edges and the alignment residual are measured from the aligned results with the tool's own maths (src/lib/relight/align.ts, blend.ts).
decides: The default engine variant, whether the light-guide picture is sent, the blend mode and the look tuning (RELIGHT_SETTINGS in src/lib/relight/engine.ts).
